ai_summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited, through its material subsidiary IL JIN Electronics, has acquired the remaining 1.50% equity stake in Ascent Circuits Private Limited via a share swap agreement. This transaction makes Ascent Circuits, a significant PCB manufacturer with FY26 turnover of Rs. 401.87 Crores, a wholly-owned subsidiary, consolidating Amber's control and simplifying operations. While identified as a related party transaction, the company explicitly states it was conducted on an arm's length basis.
